en: So I was raking leaves… and I thought: wait. What if money grew on trees?
zh: 我在掃落葉的時候突然想到：等等……如果錢會長在樹上呢？

en: I'd just pick a few bills… and buy ALL the ice cream!
zh: 我只要摘幾張鈔票……就能買下全部的冰淇淋！
say: I'd just pick a few bills... and buy all the ice cream!

en: Squirrels would hide dollars instead of nuts. And cows? Cash salad.
zh: 松鼠會藏鈔票，不藏堅果。那乳牛呢？吃鈔票沙拉。

en: But hmm… then everybody would have a money tree.
zh: 可是嗯……那每個人家裡都會有一棵搖錢樹。

en: And when everyone has tons of money… one ice cream costs $1,000!
zh: 大家的錢都多到爆……一支冰淇淋就變成一千塊！
say: And when everyone has tons of money... one ice cream costs a thousand dollars!

en: So maybe money is special… because it's hard to get?
zh: 所以……錢會珍貴，是因為它很難得到嗎？

en: I'll stick with an apple tree. At least you can eat it.
zh: 我還是種蘋果樹好了。至少可以吃！
